history.summary: PROBABLE DUPLICATE of seq 149 ('Maa Kali Mandir, Purnia', id kali-mandir-purnia) — that file already lists the exact CSV name 'Kali Mandir, Purnia' as an alternate name. This entry documents the same referent: the well-known city Kali temple on the bank of the Saura river near the Maa Puran Devi Mandir (Kalibari Chowk area), with daily worship and heavy crowds at the annual Kali Puja. Purnia has several Kali mandirs (Dakshineshwari at Rambagh Chowk, Madhubani, Mehboob Khan Tola), so the generic CSV name is ambiguous; documented here as the city Kalibari shrine. Coordinates are carried over from seq 149 (street-level approximation at Kalibari Chowk — verify). Media image is from a 'City Kalibari Mandir, Purnia' listing; the exact shrine in the photo is unconfirmed.
